title: GoldTrace Refinery Foundry Trust Policy
description: Operator-selected Foundry issuer key and exact evaluation-pack allowlist. The policy file itself must be regular, non-symlink, current-user-owned and not group/other-writable. The key file is external and no key material is shipped in this document.

authentication_key_file.description: Absolute path or path relative to this policy file. The target must be a regular non-symlink file owned by the current user with owner-only permissions.
